task: Design and render 5 orthographic reference views of a dark fantasy wanderer's cloak outfit for a male game character (no person, no mannequin, no head, no hands, no hanger): a long open-front cloak, a short layered capelet over the shoulders, a hood lying down on the back, and a soft cowl scarf round the neck. Inspired by the attached reference picture, but redesigned so the character can move its arms freely in animation without the cloth passing through the arms.
reference_picture: the attached cloak photo: copy its mood, colours and ragged worn look, not its exact cut
style: stylised 3D animated film look matching a stylised game character, clean 3D render, soft even studio lighting, plain white background, no floor shadow, whole garment in frame, identical scale and position in every view
worn_by: an invisible athletic male body with broad shoulders, 173 cm tall, standing in a T-pose (arms straight out to the sides, horizontal); the cloth hangs as if worn on that body, filled out, gravity down

design.materials: heavy brushed wool felt, near black (#1b1714) with rust-brown wear (#5a3420) along edges and folds, faint fibre texture; leather lacing and a small iron clasp at the throat
design.cowl: soft loose cowl scarf round the neck, sits on the shoulders and neck base only, does not cover the chin
design.hood: deep hood worn DOWN, folded and lying flat on the upper back between the shoulder blades; the hood opening fits a head about 25.3 cm tall when raised
design.capelet: short two-layer capelet broad and straight over the wide shoulders, V-point at the front centre, ragged fringed edges; it ends at 118.5 cm above the floor, above the elbows, and is split open at the top of each arm so the shoulder and upper arm can rise without lifting it
design.cloak: long cloak open at the front from the throat down (a 15-20 cm gap at the chest widening to the hem), fastened only by the throat clasp; hem at mid-calf, 34.6 cm above the floor, cut in large jagged tatters
arm_freedom: NO sleeves: the arms come out through the open front and through long vertical side slits
each side of the cloak has a slit from the armpit (124 cm above the floor) down to the hem, so the cloak is three hanging panels: one back panel and two front panels
the panels hang straight down from the shoulders with a clear gap of at least 4 cm round the arm in the T-pose
no cloth under the arms, no cloth between the arm and the body, nothing attached to the arms or wrists
design.leg_freedom: the cloak stays clear of the legs for walking and running: open front, side slits, and a hem well above the feet
design.holes_and_tatters: worn holes and burns are only painted or very shallow on the cloth surface, not cut through, so the cloth stays one closed surface; the ragged edge tatters are part of the silhouette
design.construction_for_3d: single layer cloth about 0.4 cm thick, every part a clean closed surface, no floating pieces, no overlapping layers passing through each other, layers separated by at least 0.5 cm; no belts, straps, gloves, boots, trousers or body underneath

views.name: back
views.description: straight back view, orthographic, centred, showing the lowered hood

views.name: side
views.description: straight left side view, orthographic, front facing left, showing the side slit

views.name: top
views.description: straight top-down view, orthographic, looking down onto the shoulders, cowl and neck opening

views.name: bottom
views.description: straight bottom-up view, orthographic, looking up into the cloak from below, showing the open front, the slits and the empty inside

output: 5 separate images (front, back, side, top, bottom), 1024x1536 portrait for front/back/side and 1024x1024 for top/bottom, same garment, same colours, same scale
